messages:
maya: Heads-up — we need to lock docs for the v0.9.2 deploy tomorrow. Any docs PRs that need to go in after cutoff require an explicit exception.

sam: Which cutoff time are we using? End of day PST?

jordan: Release notes show cutoff 2026-06-01 18:00 UTC (11:00 PT). @release-manager please confirm.

release-manager: Confirmed — branch freeze at 2026-06-01 18:00 UTC. Docs-only PRs after that need an eng lead + docs approval and the 'docs:exception' label. API changes must be on a release branch and cherry-picked.

maya: For clarity, for any PR touching the public API or SDK snippets we want: two reviewers, a passing docs preview, and the 'docs:approved' label before merge.

sam: I've got an open PR for python SDK snippets — PR is https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1762 (local id 1762). Will need review.

jordan: Left wording comments on that PR. Also CI failed on the preview build: `mkdocs build` error.

ci-bot: build failed for PR #1762 — logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/4498 — error: "Unclosed code block in docs/sdk/python/grpc.md"

sam: Thanks — I see it. Missing ``` fence around the gRPC example. Pushing a fix in ~10m.

maya: Reminder/quick checklist for merges (put in PR description please):
```
- label: docs:approved
- label: release:target=v0.9.2
- preview URL present
- 2 reviewers for API/SDK changes
- CI: mkdocs build passed
```

docs-bot: NOTE — The release gating automation enforces the above labels. If a PR merges without them it will be auto-reverted.

sam: Pushed fix at 1762003510.

ci-bot: build succeeded for PR #1762 — preview published: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-1762

jordan: Preview looks good now. Approving. :thumbsup:

maya: Approved as well. @release-manager correct process for docs after cutoff: do we allow doc-only PRs if they are purely editorial?

release-manager: Exceptions allowed only for doc-only editorial fixes that don't change code snippets or behavior. Those need eng lead + maya approval and must be micro (1-2 files). Anything that changes examples, versions, or API text requires a release-branch flow.

sam: Quick follow-up — the python snippet pins `redwood==0.8.9`. Should we bump to 0.9.0 in the example before merge?

jordan: Yes — for v0.9.2 release we should pin to 0.9.0. I'll update that in a tiny follow-up PR.

maya: I'll add a short note in CONTRIBUTING.md about the cutoff + exception process and link this thread.

sam: All set from my side. I'll merge once the labels are present.

docs-bot: PR #1762 merged by sam at 1762003725 (label check passed).

maya: Thanks everyone — closing this thread once the CONTRIBUTING.md update is in. :v:
